## Source: amazon-inspector (bb5b8b4484126f787f9917d91b6815927146a308f64bfb852c57f5d60bf4bfbb)
Analysis of fontus 0.0.3 on PyPI did not identify any code paths that exfiltrate installer data, execute attacker-controlled payloads at install or import time, relay caller-supplied data to third-party destinations, distribute live credentials, or establish persistence. No install-time network fetches, no lifecycle shell execution, no reads of credential paths (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser profiles), and no obfuscated or dynamic-exec patterns were observed.

## Source: kam193 (2a8fcff0fd4d827c6f174318ee41ea82eb2667c6d65349a01ca2215aa2f4dd5e)
The package most likely performs fingerprinting by exfiltrating basic information and available fonts, with no other functionality.
